Title: Pahadi Mandua Ka Aata (Ragi / Finger Millet Flour)
Body (HTML):
Original high-altitude finger millet flour (Mandua / Koda), slowly stone-ground in traditional Himalayan watermills (Gharats) to retain essential fibers and minerals.

Celebrated for centuries across the hills of Uttarakhand as a foundational superfood, our Pahadi Mandua Ka Aata is harvested from heirloom, non-hybrid crops cultivated in pristine mountain soil. Grown without chemical pesticides or synthetic inputs, the grain is cleaned and cold-milled slowly to protect heat-sensitive nutrients, dietary fiber, and authentic earthy aroma.

Why Pahadi Mandua is Exceptional:

  • Traditional Watermill Stone-Ground: Cold stone-milling prevents friction heat, preserving natural enzymes, antioxidants, and live nutrients.
  • Unrivaled Calcium Powerhouse: Contains significantly higher natural calcium than polished grains, promoting strong bones and joints.
  • Naturally Gluten-Free & Low GI: Excellent for blood sugar management, weight balance, and gentle everyday digestion.
  • Rich in Iron & Bio-Fiber: High mineral content supports sustained stamina, hemoglobin levels, and gut wellness.
  • 100% Pure Mountain Harvest: Directly sourced from high-elevation farmer cooperatives in Uttarakhand.

Culinary Suggestions: Enjoy authentic, rustic Mandue ki Roti brushed with Pahadi A2 Badri Cow Ghee, create wholesome breakfast porridges, fluffy pancakes, or blend 1:1 with traditional wheat flour for nutritious daily rotis.
